title: Craft vanishing into mountains in the Uinta Basin

tellings.quote: crafts vanishing into mountains is [music] a documented phenomenon, especially in places like the Uinta Basin.

plain: Unknown craft have been seen flying into mountains and vanishing, and Jesse Michels calls this a documented pattern, pointing to Utah's Uinta Basin as a place where it happens often. Michels says this himself and does not name a source. If true, it would suggest these craft have hidden places inside the land.
